scientific_integrity: All stated classifications derive from the classical Pascal–Kirkman incidence geometry, exact exhaustive finite-group orbit calculations, and field descent. A standalone exact-arithmetic verifier and its observed output are supplied. The geometric configuration is assumed incidence-generic.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on a Frobenius-stable six-point reduced divisor of a nonsingular conic over a finite field of characteristic at least seven with sixty distinct Pascal lines, sixty distinct Kirkman points, and no extra line–point incidences. No assertion about all small-field realizations, nongeneric degenerations, low characteristics, or nonreduced schemes. Full older Conway–Ryba sources not inspected for historical priority.
title: Frobenius orbit spectra and rational incidence obstructions for Pascal–Kirkman flags
